comment: Single source of truth for the agent tool surface. Python serves these over MCP, scripts/generate-agent-tools.mjs emits the Rust method lists, and pnpm agent-tools:check proves every method still has a handler. Edit here, then run pnpm agent-tools:generate.

guide.name: sikemux_guide
guide.description: Read this before your first task launch or browser click: cursors, idempotency, UI opens, and the tab model.
guide.comment: Served by the sidecar from its own bundle, so it has no harness method.

tools.name: browser_navigate
tools.description: Open a URL in the current tab, or a new one with newTab, and wait for it to load. Returns page state.

tools.name: browser_state
tools.description: Read the current tab without changing it: url, title, numbered interactive elements, visible text, and open tabs. Numbers expire on the next read.

tools.name: browser_click
tools.description: Click a numbered element from the latest state. Returns page state.

tools.name: browser_type
tools.description: Type into a numbered element, or the focused one, replacing its value. submit=true presses Enter. Returns page state.

tools.name: browser_press
tools.description: Press one key on the focused element, such as Enter, Tab, Escape, or a single character. Returns page state.

tools.name: browser_scroll
tools.description: Scroll the page, or a numbered scrollable element, by deltaY pixels; negative scrolls up.

tools.name: browser_extract
tools.description: Read the page's visible text, or only the parts matching a CSS selector.

tools.name: browser_screenshot
tools.description: Capture the visible part of the current tab as a PNG image.

tools.name: browser_wait
tools.description: Wait ms milliseconds, then for any load to finish. Returns page state.

tools.name: browser_back
tools.description: Go back in the current tab's history. Returns page state.

tools.name: browser_forward
tools.description: Go forward in the current tab's history. Returns page state.

tools.name: browser_list_tabs
tools.description: List this agent's browser tabs with their ids.

tools.name: browser_switch_tab
tools.description: Make one of this agent's tabs the current one. Returns page state.

tools.name: browser_close_tab
tools.description: Close one of this agent's tabs.

tools.name: sikemux_workspace_inspect
tools.description: Inspect this agent's open project, panes, configured tasks, runs, and event cursor.

tools.name: sikemux_task_start
tools.description: Start a configured project task in a managed terminal.

tools.name: sikemux_task_read
tools.description: Read task status and new terminal output by byte cursor.

tools.name: sikemux_task_stop
tools.description: Stop the exact managed task execution and its process tree.

tools.name: sikemux_ui_open
tools.description: Open a project file, diff, task terminal, or the configured preview.

tools.name: sikemux_events_wait
tools.description: Wait for project task or UI events after an event cursor.
